title: 第1612章 力量特性第1611章 亡灵巫师
content_zh:
“不对，空间是无敌的，他这是在剥夺我对空间力量的掌控权。”
时间为尊，空间为王，所以空间力量本身就是无敌的存在，但作为空间力量使用者的默里·格林却不是无敌之人。
拜伦·廉德动用亡灵巫力的操控特性，对默里·格林的掌控权发动了攻击，这才导致默里·格林出现了空间力量被压制的错觉。
这也是拜伦·廉德敢于和空间战法单挑的底气，他无法击败空间，但能够影响甚至是击败使用空间的人。
“亡灵掌控。”
拜伦·廉德融合的亡灵巫力越来越多，最后成功施展出了亡灵巫师的招牌巫术——亡灵掌控。
在亡灵掌控的冲击下，默里·格林失去了拜伦·廉德身体上空间力量的感应。
而失去感应，这也意味着默里·格林失去了对这部分空间力量的掌控。
“不愧是空间力量，真强大啊，但它现在归我所有了，桀桀桀。”
拜伦·廉德身上浮现出许多条灰色发光纹路，这些纹路全部汇到左手上，很快就将体内的空间力量抽了出来。
没有空间力量的影响，他身上的伤势也再快速恢复过来，并且原本浑身漆黑的他，胸口处也浮现出一抹惨白之色。
并且惨白色还在陆续朝着周围扩张，准备将他整个身躯化作惨白色，拜伦·廉德正在将自己的元素泰坦亡灵化。
手握空间力量的拜伦·廉德，将长剑横在自己胸前，然后将空间力量强行按进了长剑之中，原本漆黑的长剑，立即浮现出了复杂的灰色纹路。
“那就让你也感受一下空间的力量吧。”
说着拜伦·廉德便将加持了空间力量的长剑，朝着身前挥出，这一剑的威力不比之前的强大，但却蕴含了空间力量。
只有空间才能对抗空间，所以当此剑一出，默里·格林感觉自己的魔法领域都要被其斩开，于是他马上凝聚出大量空间导弹，将这一剑炸碎。
“亡灵巫力确实很神奇，但如果掌握这么一点空间力量就想与我对抗，甚至是战胜我的话，那就想太多了。”
空间确实能对抗空间，但很明显，默里·格林的空间更加强大。
而且拜伦·廉德的临时掌控，只能用作加持而已，确实能对默里·格林造成一些影响和伤害，但也就一些而已。
而且将拜伦·廉德的底牌掏出，并见识过亡灵巫师和亡灵巫力后，默里·格林认为现在是时候解决战斗了。

在拜伦·廉德正处巅峰状态时，将其强势击败，这才能对在场所有人形成最大冲击，让他们明白自己到底有多么强大。
因此就在默里·格林说话间，其体内的所有力量也开始汇聚融合起来，默里·格林没有巫力，但却拥有伪·空间圣力。
而在其凝聚伪·空间圣力的时候，整个魔法领域变得极其狂暴，正在凝聚亡灵巫力的拜伦·廉德，顿时感觉到一股极其恐怖的力量正在其中孕育。
他感觉在这股正在孕育的力量面前，自己就算是将身躯完成了亡灵化，掌握更多的空间力量都不是对手。
content_en:
"No, space is invincible. He is taking away my control over the power of space."
Time is supreme and space is king, so space power itself is an invincible existence, but as a user of space power, Murray Green is not invincible.
Byron Liande used the control characteristics of the undead witchcraft to launch an attack on Murray Green's control, which caused Murray Green to have the illusion that his space power was suppressed.
This is also the confidence that Byron Lian De dares to challenge space tactics. He cannot defeat space, but he can influence or even defeat the people who use space.
"Control of the Undead."
Byron Liande integrated more and more undead witchcraft, and finally successfully performed the necromancer's signature witchcraft-Undead Control.
Under the impact of the undead control, Murray Green lost the sense of space power in Byron Liande's body.
The loss of induction also means that Murray Green has lost control of this part of space power.
"It is indeed the power of space. It is so powerful, but it belongs to me now, Jie Jie Jie."
Many gray luminous lines appeared on Byron Lian De's body. These lines all merged into his left hand, and the space power in his body was quickly drawn out.
Without the influence of space power, the injuries on his body recovered quickly, and a pale color appeared on his chest, which was originally dark.
And the pale white color is still expanding towards the surroundings, preparing to turn his entire body into pale white color. Byron Lian De is turning his elemental titan into an undead.
Byron Liande, who held the space power in his hand, placed the long sword across his chest, and then forced the space power into the long sword. Complex gray lines immediately appeared on the originally dark long sword.
"Then let you feel the power of space."
As he spoke, Byron Liande swung the long sword blessed with space power in front of him. This sword was not more powerful than the previous one, but it contained space power.
Only space can fight against space, so when the sword came out, Murray Green felt that his magic field was about to be cut open by it, so he immediately condensed a large number of space missiles to blow up the sword.
"The witchcraft of the undead is indeed magical, but if you want to fight against me or even defeat me after mastering such a small amount of space power, then you are thinking too much."
Space does fight space, but it's obvious that Murray Green's space is more powerful.
Moreover, Byron Liande's temporary control can only be used as a blessing. It can indeed cause some influence and harm to Murray Green, but only a little.
And after taking out Byron Liand's trump card and seeing the necromancers and the power of the undead, Murray Green believed that now is the time to resolve the battle.
Defeating Byron Lian De when he is at his peak will have the biggest impact on everyone present and let them understand how powerful he is.
Therefore, as Murray Green spoke, all the powers in his body began to converge and merge. Murray Green did not have witchcraft power, but he possessed pseudo-space holy power.
When he was condensing the pseudo-space holy power, the entire magic field became extremely violent. Byron Liande, who was condensing the undead witchcraft power, suddenly felt that an extremely terrifying power was being nurtured within it.
He felt that in front of this gestating power, even if he completed the undead transformation of his body and mastered more space power, he would not be a match.
